What does it take to identify opportunity, build successful companies, and invest in the next generation of entrepreneurs?

In this insightful conversation, Open Opportunity Fund Managing Partner Paul Judge and business leader, investor, and San Diego Wave FC owner Lauren Leichtman join Forbes Senior Editor Alex Knapp to discuss the evolving landscape of entrepreneurship, capital formation, and technology-driven growth.

The panel explores investment strategies that empower founders, the importance of aligning incentives between investors and management teams, and how access to capital can help businesses scale and create lasting value. Judge and Leichtman share lessons from decades of investing across industries, from technology and cybersecurity to private equity and professional sports.

description:
What does it really mean to start from the bottom—and how do you rise above it?

In this powerful conversation, Operation HOPE Founder, Chairman & CEO John Hope Bryant and HappYness CEO Chris Gardner explore the realities of adversity, resilience, and building success from difficult beginnings. From experiences with homelessness and hardship to lessons in ownership, personal responsibility, and economic mobility, this discussion reveals the mindset shifts that can transform obstacles into opportunities.

Jabari Young sits down with the CEOs to discuss why success requires more than a dream—it demands a plan, commitment, and the courage to keep moving forward when life gets difficult. They share practical insights on overcoming rejection, staying focused on your purpose, and creating pathways to financial freedom through education, trades, and financial literacy.

description:
What does it take to overcome adversity and build a life of impact?

In this inspiring conversation, Promise CEO & Founder Phaedra Ellis-Lamkins and IT Cosmetics Cofounder Jamie Kern Lima share their personal journeys from challenging beginnings to extraordinary success. From surviving poverty and abuse to overcoming rejection and self-doubt, they reveal the mindset shifts, values, and decisions that helped them create meaningful change in the world.

The discussion explores the power of trusting your instincts, staying true to your mission, and rejecting conventional wisdom when it doesn't align with your purpose. The speakers also reflect on the influence of mentors like Oprah Winfrey, the importance of self-worth, and why authenticity can be one of the greatest competitive advantages in business and life.
